question: What is the long passing score of the oldest player?
evidence: long passing score refers to long_passing; oldest player refers to oldest birthday;
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT t2.long_passing AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.birthday ASC) AS __r FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT t2.long_passing FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id ORDER BY t1.birthday ASC LIMIT 1

c.sql: SELECT pa.long_passing FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player)

b.request: Return the `long_passing` score from every attribute record for every player whose `birthday` is the earliest in `Player`, including all players tied for that birthday
b.sql: SELECT pa.long_passing FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player)

d.request: What is the long passing score of each player tied for the earliest birthday?
d.sql: SELECT p.player_name, pa.long_passing FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MIN(birthday) FROM Player);
